### Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten")  
**Conditions:**
- Data no longer necessary for purpose
- No legal obligation to retain
- No legitimate interest in retention
- Customer withdraws consent (if basis)  
**Exceptions (Data Retained Even if Requested):**
- Legal/regulatory obligation (AML, KYC records)
- Ongoing disputes or complaints
- Fraud investigation
- Financial claim pending
- Active account or product

raw_entities.name: Right to Erasure Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the conditions under which customer personal data may be erased or deleted, including the legal and operational exceptions that override erasure requests. The policy balances data subject rights against regulatory retention obligations and legitimate business interests.
context: Data no longer necessary for purpose

raw_entities.name: Data Necessity Assessment for Erasure
raw_entities.description: Requirement to evaluate whether personal data remains necessary for its original purpose before processing an erasure request. Data must be assessed as no longer necessary before erasure can be considered.
context: Data no longer necessary for purpose

raw_entities.name: Legal Obligation Retention Override
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on erasure when a legal or regulatory obligation requires data retention. Specifically applies to AML and KYC records which must be retained regardless of erasure requests.

raw_entities.name: Legitimate Interest Retention Override
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on erasure when the bank has a documented legitimate interest in retaining the data. Overrides erasure requests when legitimate business interests are identified.

raw_entities.name: Consent Withdrawal Erasure Trigger
raw_entities.description: Requirement to process erasure requests when consent is the legal basis for processing and the customer withdraws that consent. Applies only when consent was the original lawful basis.

raw_entities.name: Dispute and Complaint Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on erasure of data when ongoing disputes or complaints exist. Data must be retained to support resolution and investigation of customer disputes.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on erasure of data when fraud investigation is active or pending. Data must be retained to support fraud detection, investigation, and prevention activities.

raw_entities.name: Financial Claim Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on erasure of data when a financial claim is pending against the customer or the bank. Data must be retained to support claim resolution and potential litigation.

raw_entities.name: Active Account or Product Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on erasure of data relating to active customer accounts or products. Data must be retained while the customer maintains an active banking relationship.

raw_entities.name: Anti-Money Laundering Records
raw_entities.description: Regulatory requirement to retain customer identification and transaction records for anti-money laundering purposes. Referenced as a mandatory exception to data erasure requests.

raw_entities.name: Know Your Customer Records
raw_entities.description: Regulatory requirement to retain customer identity verification and due diligence documentation. Referenced as a mandatory exception to data erasure requests.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of fraudulent activity by customers or third parties. The policy identifies fraud investigation as a legitimate reason to retain customer data despite erasure requests.

raw_entities.name: Compliance and Regulatory Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of regulatory non-compliance and sanctions resulting from improper data retention or erasure. The policy balances data subject rights against mandatory regulatory retention obligations.

raw_entities.name: Dispute and Complaint Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of unresolved customer disputes and complaints. The policy identifies ongoing disputes as a reason to retain data for investigation and resolution.

raw_entities.name: Financial Claim Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of financial claims and potential litigation. The policy identifies pending financial claims as a reason to retain customer data.

properties.core_policy_statement: Customer data may be erased when no longer necessary for purpose, no legal obligation exists, no legitimate interest applies, and consent is withdrawn, subject to regulatory and operational exceptions
properties.scope_summary: Applies to personal data held by the bank; excludes data subject to legal/regulatory retention obligations (AML, KYC), ongoing disputes, fraud investigations, pending financial claims, and active account data

properties.core_requirement: Data must be assessed as no longer necessary for its original purpose before erasure is permitted
Data subject to legal or regulatory obligation must be retained regardless of erasure request
Data retained for legitimate interest purposes must not be erased solely on customer request
Erasure must be permitted when customer withdraws consent, unless other legal basis applies

applies_to: data related to ongoing disputes or complaints
properties.consequence_of_breach: Loss of evidence; inability to defend complaint or dispute resolution
properties.core_requirement: Data must be retained while dispute or complaint is ongoing, regardless of erasure request

properties.consequence_of_breach: Compromise of fraud investigation; regulatory violation
properties.core_requirement: Data must be retained during active fraud investigation, regardless of erasure request

applies_to: data related to pending financial claims
properties.consequence_of_breach: Loss of evidence; inability to defend or pursue financial claim
properties.core_requirement: Data must be retained while financial claim is pending, regardless of erasure request

properties.name: Active Account or Product Data Retention

applies_to: data related to active accounts or products
properties.consequence_of_breach: Inability to service account or product; operational failure
properties.core_requirement: Data must be retained for active accounts or products, regardless of erasure request

properties.key_obligation: Retain AML records for specified period; do not erase upon customer request if legal obligation applies
properties.how_cited: Referenced as exception to Right to Erasure

properties.key_obligation: Retain KYC records for specified period; do not erase upon customer request if legal obligation applies
properties.how_cited: Referenced as exception to Right to Erasure

properties.risk_definition: Risk that fraudulent activity may be ongoing or under investigation
properties.required_response: Retain all data related to fraud investigation; do not permit erasure

properties.risk_definition: Risk of regulatory breach if data subject to legal obligation is erased
properties.required_response: Retain data subject to AML, KYC, or other legal obligation; do not permit erasure

properties.risk_definition: Risk of inability to defend or resolve dispute or complaint if supporting data is erased
properties.required_response: Retain all data related to ongoing dispute or complaint; do not permit erasure
properties.reporting_obligation: Escalate to dispute resolution or complaints team

properties.risk_definition: Risk of inability to defend or pursue financial claim if supporting data is erased
properties.required_response: Retain all data related to pending financial claim; do not permit erasure
properties.reporting_obligation: Escalate to legal or claims team
